findings.rationale: Sponsor uses an in-house primary reference standard for Synthetic Compound X. Lot number IH-SCX-2024-001 is provided. The in-house standard is fully characterised by IR, UV, NMR, and MS spectroscopy. A certificate of analysis (CoA) has been submitted with purity assigned at 99.4% by mass balance. Overlaid IR spectra of the in-house RS and the drug substance batch are submitted confirming identity. Working standard WS-SCX-IH-002 has been qualified against the in-house primary reference standard. Source of standards: in-house preparation at ABC Analytical Laboratory.
findings.evidence_snippet: Lot no. IH-SCX-2024-001. CoA submitted; purity 99.4% by mass balance. IR, UV, NMR, MS characterisation complete. Overlaid IR spectra submitted. Working standard WS-SCX-IH-002 qualified against in-house primary. Source: ABC Analytical Laboratory.
findings.citation: In-house characterisation report, ABC Analytical Laboratory, Ref. IH-SCX-2024-001-CR, 2024.

findings.note: All IPRP S.5 sub-item indicators present: lot number (IH-SCX-2024-001), CoA, IR spectra (overlaid), working standard, source. R4–R6 all pass. No section-escalation threshold met.
